details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The predicted date, March 4, 2026, does not match the gold date, January 5, 1981.
details.groundedness_reasoning: 1. The gold target claims the date was January 5, 1981. 2. No retrieved citation identifies that date as the KOSPI’s largest relative single-day drop. 3. Citation [3] says the KOSPI was first announced in 1983, which conflicts with the proposed 1981 date. Citation [2] instead identifies September 12, 2001 as the previous record date. Therefore the citations do not support the gold target.
